lesson.meaning: What you plan or aim to do; your purpose.
examples: My intention was to finish this report by lunch, but I had an urgent call.
What's the intention behind this new marketing campaign?
His intention to collaborate on the project was clear from his presentation.
I had no intention of offending anyone with my feedback.
The management's intention is to streamline our processes for better efficiency.
lesson.memory_tip: Remember, your 'intention' is simply what you 'intend' to do. They are very closely related!
